name: live encyclopedia fetch (breadth fix: ML x life/culture)
rule: R11 — full breadth of human life/culture on one axis, newest-ML (1-6mo) on the other. Merge target = ML technique x distant life/culture concept.

life_culture_concepts.name: Koji staged temperature cultivation
life_culture_concepts.mechanism: Maker monitors metabolic heat of A. oryzae on rice and intervenes at trigger temps (mori ~18-22h; naka 35C; shimai 38.5C; never >43C), each cooling resetting the heat cycle to tune protease-vs-amylase enzyme profile by timing.

life_culture_concepts.name: Kombucha back-slopping acidification loop
life_culture_concepts.mechanism: ~10% finished kombucha (pH<=3.5) added to fresh sweet tea instantly drops pH below mold threshold, so the prior batch's own acid is a selective inoculant excluding contaminants before they colonize.

life_culture_concepts.name: Fish-sauce salt-layer autolysis control
life_culture_concepts.mechanism: 25-30% salt simultaneously suppresses spoilage microbes and gates endogenous visceral proteases; salt ratio is the single control parameter switching the system between enzyme-dominated (slow) and microbe-dominated (fast/risky) regimes.

life_culture_concepts.name: Double-Ikat resist-binding registration
life_culture_concepts.mechanism: Warp and weft bundles are independently resist-tied and dyed before weaving; the pattern only materializes at the intersection of two separately-controlled dye systems, each crossing a combinatorial product with no mid-weave correction.

life_culture_concepts.name: Togidashi Maki-e subtractive reveal
life_culture_concepts.mechanism: Metal powder design is buried under opaque black lacquer, then progressively polished until the image emerges flush — revelation by subtraction from a uniform skin, not additive application.

life_culture_concepts.name: Celadon iron-reduction firing
life_culture_concepts.mechanism: Oxygen-starved kiln converts Fe3+ to Fe2+; final hue is set by the Fe2+/Fe3+ ratio and thus by precise timing/intensity of the reducing atmosphere during the firing schedule.

life_culture_concepts.name: Constrictor-knot self-jamming
life_culture_concepts.mechanism: Load drives the riding turn deeper into the nip point via the capstan effect, so friction multiplies with applied tension — the binding gets progressively, irreversibly tighter under load.

life_culture_concepts.name: Kigumi interlocking joinery
life_culture_concepts.mechanism: Stepped/angled profiles permit only one insertion path; seated load drives angled shoulders into mating recesses so the joint tightens under the very forces it resists — no fasteners.

life_culture_concepts.name: Coiled-basketry continuous-spiral binding
life_culture_concepts.mechanism: A weft stitch pierced through each preceding coil redistributes tension around the whole preceding ring; each loop locks its neighbors so rigidity arises with no single point of failure.

life_culture_concepts.name: Maya Calendar Round (coprime LCM addressing)
life_culture_concepts.mechanism: 260-day Tzolkin and 365-day Haab run as independent counters; LCM=18,980 gives unique paired addresses for 52 years with NO intercalation — coprime-reduced cycle lengths arithmetically guarantee a non-repeating address space.

life_culture_concepts.name: Arabic Geomancy XOR parity cascade
life_culture_concepts.mechanism: 4 random 4-bit Mothers deterministically generate 11 figures via column-transpose + adjacent XOR-parity addition; the final Judge's mandatory even total is a parity checksum verifying the whole cascade.

life_culture_concepts.name: Aboriginal Songlines multi-modal redundancy
life_culture_concepts.mechanism: Each waypoint/law/fact is encoded simultaneously across 4 independent substrates (melody, dance, narrative, landscape); identical info recoverable from any one channel, so loss requires simultaneous failure of all four.

life_culture_concepts.name: Subak synchronized-fallow irrigation
life_culture_concepts.mechanism: Hierarchical water temples coordinate simultaneous fallow across contiguous terraces; synchronized drought starves pests of habitat while the same calendar sequences water draws — pest control and allocation solved by one shared schedule.

life_culture_concepts.name: Coppicing stool-shoot regrowth
life_culture_concepts.mechanism: Cutting removes apical-auxin suppression; the intact carbohydrate-rich root redirects its surplus to released buds, producing many fast shoots — each harvest faster because the root reserve only grows between cuts.

life_culture_concepts.name: Etak star-compass dead-reckoning
life_culture_concepts.mechanism: A side reference island is tracked through 32 star-compass houses while the canoe is treated as stationary; each house-crossing marks a discrete voyage segment — converts open-ended dead reckoning into finite discrete checks with no absolute coordinate.

life_culture_concepts.name: Swiss pairing self-stratification
life_culture_concepts.mechanism: Each round pairs equal-cumulative-score players without elimination and without repeats; the field self-sorts so every match stays competitively balanced over ~log2(N) rounds.

life_culture_concepts.name: Crokinole compulsory-contact penalty
life_culture_concepts.mechanism: If a shot fails to strike an opponent disc, the shooter's disc and everything it moved (incl. scored 20s) are removed — a forced-aggression rule that penalizes passive accumulation.

life_culture_concepts.name: Misere-Nim parity inversion
life_culture_concepts.mechanism: Strategy mirrors normal Nim (hold nim-sum 0 for opponent) EXCEPT in the terminal all-piles-<=1 state, where you leave an odd number of singletons — a single local rule inversion only at the boundary.

life_culture_concepts.name: Change-ringing Plain-Bob permutation traversal
life_culture_concepts.mechanism: Fixed local adjacent-swap rules move any bell at most one position per row, tracing a Hamiltonian circuit through all n! permutations once; 'bob'/'single' calls redirect the path at lead-ends to avoid premature return.

life_culture_concepts.name: Balinese Kotekan complementary-gap interlock
life_culture_concepts.mechanism: Two players each play an individually-incomplete line whose rests coincide with the other's notes, so their interlock yields one fast composite melody neither part contains alone.

life_culture_concepts.name: Ebru alum-mordant surface-lift transfer
life_culture_concepts.mechanism: Ox-gall pigments float on viscous size and are raked into a pattern; an alum-mordanted sheet laid on top binds the entire floating layer on contact, transferring the whole pattern intact in a single lift.

life_culture_concepts.name: Inca Khipu multi-channel knot encoding
life_culture_concepts.mechanism: Knot type + position sets decimal place value while cord color, fiber, ply-twist direction, and attachment angle each add independent data dimensions — a multi-channel positional encoding without script.

life_culture_concepts.name: ROSCA/Tanda rotating credit pool
life_culture_concepts.mechanism: N members contribute fixed C per period; the full pot rotates to one member per cycle, making early recipients net borrowers and late recipients net savers from the same pool — credit and savings in one, enforced by social trust.

life_culture_concepts.name: Oral-formulaic composition (Parry-Lord)
life_culture_concepts.mechanism: A repertoire of metrically-sized, case-inflected noun-epithet formulas is slotted in real time to fill metrical positions, generating valid new lines by substitution without fixed memorization.

newest_ml_concepts.name: Evolving Deep Learning Optimizers
newest_ml_concepts.mechanism: GA encodes optimizers as interpretable genomes (gradient/momentum/RMS/sign primitives) and evolves them to discover update rules outperforming Adam.

newest_ml_concepts.name: Critical Sharpness (loss-landscape curvature proxy)
newest_ml_concepts.mechanism: A cheap (<10 forward pass) proxy for Hessian sharpness capturing progressive sharpening / Edge-of-Stability, scalable to 7B pretraining to guide data mixing.

newest_ml_concepts.name: Optimal LR-Schedule theory (random-feature scaling)
newest_ml_concepts.mechanism: Optimal-control derivation of closed-form LR schedules on a solvable power-law model, revealing an easy phase (poly decay) and hard phase (warmup-stable-decay).

newest_ml_concepts.name: Log-Linear Attention
newest_ml_concepts.mechanism: Replaces linear attention's fixed-size hidden state with a logarithmically growing set of states, giving a matmul-rich parallel form at log-linear cost while recovering much softmax expressivity.

newest_ml_concepts.name: Variational Linear Attention (VLA)
newest_ml_concepts.mechanism: Casts the linear-attention memory write as online regularized least-squares with an adaptive penalty (Sherman-Morrison rank-1 updates), giving spectral-norm-1 recurrence and provably stable associative memory.

newest_ml_concepts.name: Emergence Transformer (Dynamical Temporal Attention)
newest_ml_concepts.mechanism: Time-varying Q/K/V matrices let each token attend over its own and neighbors' past states via dynamical kernels, modeling oscillatory/temporal emergence beyond static attention.

newest_ml_concepts.name: VeriCache
newest_ml_concepts.mechanism: Drafts tokens from a lossy-compressed KV cache while the full cache is offloaded to CPU/NVMe, then verifies against the full cache by overlapping decode with PCIe swap — lossless quality at near-compressed throughput.

newest_ml_concepts.name: ZipServ
newest_ml_concepts.mechanism: Tensor-Core-Aware Triple Bitmap Encoding + fused ZipGEMM decompresses weights on-the-fly into Tensor Core registers, ~30% smaller model, 2.21x kernel speedup, lossless.

newest_ml_concepts.name: PARD (Parallel Draft)
newest_ml_concepts.mechanism: Conditional Drop-token training turns autoregressive drafts into parallel multi-token predictors; one target-independent draft serves a model family, 1.78x over AR drafting, up to 4.08x end-to-end.

newest_ml_concepts.name: ProGRPO
newest_ml_concepts.mechanism: Reshapes GRPO advantage using the model's own prompt-perplexity and answer-confidence to attenuate over-confident paths and redistribute gradient mass to under-explored correct chains, fighting mode collapse.

newest_ml_concepts.name: MASPO
newest_ml_concepts.mechanism: Replaces GRPO hard-clipping with a soft Gaussian gradient gate + mass-adaptive token-distribution limiter + asymmetric risk controller for more stable RLVR.

newest_ml_concepts.name: AutoTTS
newest_ml_concepts.mechanism: A coding-agent LLM auto-synthesizes and refines code-defined test-time-scaling controllers (branch/continue/prune/stop) in a replay-backed environment, replacing hand-crafted TTS heuristics.
